theorems.name: Submission.deGiorgi_measurableSet_reducedBoundary
theorems.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (U : Set (Rn N)) (μ : Measure (Rn N)) (ν : Rn N → Rn N), IsOpen U → μ Uᶜ = 0 → (∀ K : Set (Rn N), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → μ K < ∞) → AEStronglyMeasurable ν μ → (∀ᵐ y ∂μ, ‖ν y‖ = 1) → MeasurableSet (reducedBoundary U μ ν)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
